correctness.rationale: For any prime p>=5, exactly p cyclic vertex orbits are full invariant matchings; reduced real cyclic permutation module has free sphere action with L(p;1,...,(p-1)/2) links. Removing p disjoint neighborhoods yields simply connected U with H2(U)=Z/3 at p=5 and zero for p>=7 by Shareshian–Wachs and Jonsson. Cartan–Leray computes H2(U/Cp); H3(Cp)=Zp cannot hit Z3. Each lens link maps isomorphically on pi1 to Cp. Van Kampen kills pi1; Mayer–Vietoris yields H2 extension of (Zp)^(p-1) by Z3 only at p=5. Primary decomposition splits; Hurewicz gives pi2. Full p=5,p=7 face enumerations and p=5 barycentric chain ranks over F2,F3,F5 independently agree.

value.rationale: An infinite family of canonical square chessboard complexes with growing intrinsic connectivity acquires an elementary p-primary second homotopy group of exact rank p-1 after a natural nonfree symmetry quotient. The exceptional first prime simultaneously carries intrinsic 3-primary and induced 5-primary torsion. This distinguishes free from semifree quotients and directly quantifies a natural topological obstruction rather than computing an arbitrary small parameter.
